run_SpotSkillManager_pick_loop: run a loop that picks an object using SpotSkillManager with mobile pick and end effector gaze enabled
create_SpotSkillManager_instance: create a SpotSkillManager instance with use_mobile_pick and use_pick_ee set to True
test_SpotSkillManager_pick: test the SpotSkillManager pick method by picking a named object like Frosted Flakes Cup
run_SpotSkillManager_open_gripper: run the open_gripper method on the SpotSkillManager spot attribute to release the gripper
run_SpotSkillManager_dock: run the dock method on SpotSkillManager to navigate to the dock and shutdown
